1.explanation:
• button.config.js – storybook and variant definitions for all button types live here. We need to add or update an “expressive” variant (48px height, 16px label) so designers can preview it alongside primary/secondary/ghost.

• list.config.js – catalog of list variants (unordered, ordered, native). To add an expressive List style in the component library, we must introduce a new variant here that sets `$body-long-02` and the 24px line height.

• Button.js – the React implementation reads size/kind props and applies CSS classes. To support the new 48px-tall, 16px-text expressive button, Button.js must recognize a new size or variant token and map it to the correct CSS class or inline style.

• UnorderedList.js – the React wrapper that renders `<ul>` with Carbon list classes. It will need to handle an expressive prop or className (e.g. `--list--expressive`) so it applies the new font size and line height. (OrderedList.js is similar, but we hit the four-file limit.)
1.bug_scenario: The screenshots compare the current Carbon defaults (14px “short-01” text, 40px button height, tighter list indent and 18px line-height) against the requested “expressive” treatment: buttons at 48px tall with 16px label (using body-long-02, 24px/1.5 line height) and lists rendered at 16px/24px spacing (also body-long-02) with a larger wrap width and consistent 16px hanging indent.
